subject: a Greek-Macedonian queen of Ptolemaic Egypt with a strong profile, aquiline nose and firm chin, dark hair braided in a melon-style bun under a plain white royal diadem band, wearing a draped Greek linen chiton and himation with a gold brooch, calm intelligent eyes

panels.01-alexandria: the harbour of Alexandria in 69 BC at golden hour, the tall Pharos lighthouse, Greek temples and colonnades beside Egyptian obelisks, merchant ships with square sails, wide establishing shot
panels.02-library: a young Greek-Egyptian princess of about ten in a simple linen chiton studying papyrus scrolls with an older Greek tutor among tall scroll shelves in the Library of Alexandria, sunlight through columns, 1st century BC
panels.03-hermonthis: {S}, aged eighteen, standing at the prow of a royal Nile boat with Egyptian priests in white linen, a sacred black bull garlanded with flowers on the riverbank, palm trees and temple pylons near Thebes, 51 BC, solemn and dignified
panels.04-caesar: {S} speaking with confidence to Julius Caesar, a balding Roman general in a toga with a purple border, inside a marble palace hall in Alexandria, 48 BC, maps and scrolls on a table, tense diplomatic meeting
panels.05-dendera: a monumental Egyptian temple wall at Dendera carved with large reliefs of a queen and a young pharaoh making offerings to the gods, hieroglyphs as decorative carving, sunlit sandstone, stonemasons on wooden scaffolding, 1st century BC
panels.06-tarsus: {S} reclining under a gold-spangled canopy on a magnificent royal barge with a gilded stern, purple sails and silver oars, sailing up the river Cydnus toward the city of Tarsus in 41 BC, crowds gathering on the riverbanks, musicians with flutes, golden light
panels.07-actium: ancient war galleys with oars and bronze rams massed on the sea off Actium in 31 BC, an Egyptian squadron raising its sails and breaking away toward open water under a stormy sky, strategy and motion, no blood
panels.08-lastqueen: {S} in full royal state with diadem seated alone at a writing table in a stone mausoleum chamber in Alexandria in 30 BC, sealing a wax tablet, late evening light through a high window over the sea, calm, dignified, resolute
